headline: Opening Night: Zero Fox Given, Literally
subhead: Paul George dropped 38, Wembanyama went 1 for 13, and Zero Fox Given never took the floor.

zingers.line: Not one player suited up on opening night. Down 6-1, and the only category won was turnovers. By doing nothing.
Jayson Tatum went 6 for 23 and 0 for 7 from three. Thirteen team points, trailing in eight categories.
Thirteen points as a team. Wembanyama scored 12 by himself while shooting 1 for 13. That is the gap.
Paul George hung 38 with seven threes and still only got a 5-5 tie. Zero offensive boards, zero blocks.
Jalen Duren was the only MONSTAR who played. Twenty-two points, and still down 3-6.
Jalen Brunson went 6 for 19 and the whole team managed five assists. Down 4-7 before most rosters even played.
Joel Embiid went 4 for 15 with four turnovers and the lead is still 7-4. Thank the schedule, not the roster.
